description:
User-directed plan: move complete generic linked-device management into jido_chat_whatsapp. Latest request updates planning only; coding remains paused during this turn. Existing local dependency setup is retained; no commit/push/merge/publication authorized.

Definition of done: delete the entire lib/zaq/channels/linked_device/ directory, including session.ex, temporary_storage.ex, storage.ex and session_storage.ex. Generic functionality moves upstream, not to another ZAQ directory. Existing lib/zaq/channels/linked_device.ex may remain a thin host configuration/binding/lifecycle facade.

Audit: Session currently owns provisional runtime, owner monitoring, TTL, identity confirmation, freezing and persistence retry/handoff. TemporaryStorage owns bounded mutable/frozen records. Storage mixes generic namespace routing/serialization with Engine authorization; SessionStorage owns Mnesia. Existing PairLinkedDevice Action authorizes operators; ConfirmLinkedDevice/Engine.LinkedDeviceConfirmation owns atomic connector persistence; credential_document owns encrypted records. Preserve those host operations.

Package ownership: explicit Mnesia infrastructure and recovery; bounded temporary backend; generic pairing lifecycle; snapshot freeze/selection; configurable composite routing/serialization; confirmation retry/idempotency and seed/start sequencing. Reuse ConnectionWorker/Adapter/GuardedStorage; package has no ZAQ module, permission model, Ecto or encryption-key dependency.

Host ownership: operator authorization, exact connector/profile/credential binding, trusted per-operation authorization callbacks (including RAM), canonical encrypted Connect CRUD, atomic connector creation, selected namespace/deployment policy and saved runtime start through existing Actions/NodeRouter/facades. Do not retain a local pairing state machine or storage router.

Preserved split: paired credentials/supporting records stay encrypted in DB; session/sender_key stay in node-local RAM. Package routes according to host policy. Confirmation stops writes, freezes, invokes idempotent durable host save, seeds RAM once and invokes runtime start. Save failure retains frozen retry state; post-save failure reports saved/runtime_pending. Keep identity-presented guard, owner isolation and no raw secrets in public status/logs. Existing durable record encoding remains compatible; no SQL migration implied.

web_widget influence: explicit host-supervised package infrastructure; validated immutable init options; readiness separate from startup; generation fencing; safe shared-Mnesia shutdown. Reconcile existing automatic Amarula transport and start_runtime:false with one owner. Distinguish Mnesia OTP application startup from package table configuration. ZAQ strict RAM-only schema preserved; no replica_nodes/quorum/replication scope expansion.

Action reuse: extend existing generic package APIs and reuse host PairLinkedDevice, ConfirmLinkedDevice and credential_document. No new Actions/tools for internal protocol operations. Each child contains pre-implementation tests, branches, mocking and documentation plans.

Existing issues: zaq-0l7.13.1 is prior backend baseline; zaq-0l7.22 recovery defect stays open until upstream regression proof, without reviving its reverted local fix. zaq-0l7.24.7 tracks already-applied local dependency setup and retains its status. Preserve unrelated edits in both checkouts.

E2E: behavior-preserving extraction, no UI redesign. Keep current BO response contracts and existing onboarding/restart/full-flow assertions. No new feature E2E authoring required unless journeys change; reassess and apply UX approval gate if they do.

Execution sequence: zaq-0l7.24.1 -> zaq-0l7.24.2 -> zaq-0l7.24.3 -> zaq-0l7.24.8 -> zaq-0l7.24.9 -> zaq-0l7.24.10 -> zaq-0l7.24.11 -> zaq-0l7.24.4 -> zaq-0l7.24.5 -> zaq-0l7.24.6. Linear DAG, no diamonds; only contract step ready within implementation sequence. Local setup .7 remains independent.

Read owning AGENTS.md and ZAQ workflow, action-reuse, testing, system-config and documentation policies as applicable. Use real internal state/process/DB boundaries; mock only external WhatsApp transport or package host-callback boundary in upstream standalone tests. Isolate global Mnesia tests in separate BEAMs. Runtime dependency seams use explicit public options. Preserve current UI journeys; run relevant existing tests, no new feature E2E authoring unless scope changes and the required UX approval is recorded. Follow post-review coverage and final validation gates; no automatic commit/push/publication.

comments.text: Implementation complete in both local working trees. All four ZAQ linked_device source modules removed; generic storage/property tests migrated upstream; no Zaq module references in package source. Existing facade retains only authorized host callbacks. Accepted explicit web_widget-style infrastructure and encrypted DB/RAM split verified. Final precommit passed. No commits/pushes/publication. Open handoff: review-triggered coverage and eventual production pin.

PR #847 agreed remediation is now tracked in zaq-e5z. Reused open issues zaq-0l7.24.6 moved under that epic without duplication; IDs/history/dependency links remain intact. Their descriptions retain earlier requirements plus the explicitly approved points 2–5. This does not mark the historical feature complete.
